mapper.select: SELECT r.menu_id,r.ingredient_id, COALESCE(lot.product_name_snapshot,ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw,i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name, lot.supplier_product_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(lot.origin_name_snapshot,''),'원산지 미확인') origin_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail r LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master ai ON ai.account_id=r.account_id AND ai.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i ON i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot lot ON lot.inventory_lot_id=( SELECT l.inventory_lot_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot l WHERE l.account_id=r.account_id AND l.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id ORDER BY l.received_date DESC,l.inventory_lot_id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE r.account_id=#{account_id} AND r.menu_id=#{menu_id} ORDER BY r.menu_id,r.ingredient_seq

SELECT #{account_id} account_id,ai.ingredient_id, COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_std) ingredient_name_std,COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_raw,i.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name_raw, COALESCE(ai.category_name,i.category_name) category_name,ai.base_unit,COALESCE(ai.storage_type,i.storage_type) storage_type, COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw,i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw) ingredient_name, usage_rows.menu_usage_count,COALESCE(lot.product_name_snapshot,p.product_name) product_name,lot.supplier_product_id,s.supplier_name FROM (SELECT rd.ingredient_id,COUNT(DISTINCT rd.menu_id) menu_usage_count FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master m ON m.account_id=rd.account_id AND m.menu_id=rd.menu_id AND m.del_yn='N' WHERE rd.account_id=#{account_id} GROUP BY rd.ingredient_id) usage_rows JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master ai ON ai.account_id=#{account_id} AND ai.ingredient_id=usage_rows.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i ON i.ingredient_id=usage_rows.ingredient_id
LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot lot ON lot.inventory_lot_id=( SELECT l.inventory_lot_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot l WHERE l.account_id=#{account_id} AND l.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id ORDER BY l.received_date DESC,l.inventory_lot_id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=lot.supplier_product_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id ai.ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id} ORDER BY ingredient_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master(account_id,ingredient_id,ingredient_name_raw,ingredient_name_std,category_name,base_unit,storage_type,needs_review,note,active_yn,user_id) VALUES(#{account_id},#{ingredient_id},#{ingredient_name_raw},#{ingredient_name_std},#{category_name},#{base_unit},#{storage_type},COALESCE(#{needs_review},0),#{note},COALESCE(#{active_yn},'Y'),#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ingredient_name_raw=VALUES(ingredient_name_raw),ingredient_name_std=VALUES(ingredient_name_std),category_name=VALUES(category_name),base_unit=VALUES(base_unit),storage_type=VALUES(storage_type),needs_review=VALUES(needs_review),note=VALUES(note),active_yn=VALUES(active_yn),user_id=VALUES(user_id),mod_at=NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND menu_id=#{menu_id} AND meal_plan_type=#{meal_plan_type} AND del_yn='N' ORDER BY menu_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master(account_id,menu_id,menu_name_raw,menu_name,food_type,food_type_reason,menu_type,menu_gubun,meal_plan_type,calories_per_serving,del_yn,user_id) VALUES(#{account_id},#{menu_id},#{menu_name_raw},#{menu_name},#{food_type},#{food_type_reason},#{menu_type},#{menu_gubun},COALESCE(#{meal_plan_type},0),#{calories_per_serving},COALESCE(#{del_yn},'N'),#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE menu_name_raw=VALUES(menu_name_raw),menu_name=VALUES(menu_name),food_type=VALUES(food_type),food_type_reason=VALUES(food_type_reason),menu_type=VALUES(menu_type),menu_gubun=VALUES(menu_gubun),meal_plan_type=VALUES(meal_plan_type),calories_per_serving=COALESCE(VALUES(calories_per_serving),calories_per_serving),del_yn=VALUES(del_yn),user_id=VALUES(user_id),mod_at=NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master SET del_yn='Y',user_id=#{user_id},mod_at=NOW() WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND menu_id=#{menu_id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT base_unit FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id}), (SELECT base_unit FROM the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master WHERE ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id}))
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master SET active_yn='Y',user_id=#{user_id},mod_at=NOW() WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id} AND active_yn<>'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id}
SELECT base_unit FROM the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master WHERE ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id}

SELECT r.*,i.ingredient_name_std FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master i ON i.account_id=r.account_id AND i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id WHERE r.account_id=#{account_id} AND r.menu_id=#{menu_id} AND r.recipe_id=#{recipe_id} ORDER BY r.menu_id,r.ingredient_seq
SELECT MIN(recipe_id) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND menu_id=#{menu_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail(account_id,recipe_id,menu_id,ingredient_id,ingredient_seq,ingredient_name_raw,qty_raw,qty_num,qty_unit,recipe_yield_servings,qty_base,base_unit,qty_per_person,review_flag,user_id) VALUES(#{account_id},#{recipe_id},#{menu_id},#{ingredient_id},COALESCE(#{ingredient_seq},1),#{ingredient_name_raw},#{qty_raw},#{qty_num},#{qty_unit},#{recipe_yield_servings},#{qty_base},#{base_unit},#{qty_per_person},CASE WHEN #{review_flag} IS NULL OR #{review_flag}='' OR #{review_flag}='0' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ingredient_id=VALUES(ingredient_id),ingredient_name_raw=VALUES(ingredient_name_raw),qty_raw=VALUES(qty_raw),qty_num=VALUES(qty_num),qty_unit=VALUES(qty_unit),recipe_yield_servings=VALUES(recipe_yield_servings),qty_base=VALUES(qty_base),base_unit=VALUES(base_unit),qty_per_person=VALUES(qty_per_person),review_flag=VALUES(review_flag),user_id=VALUES(user_id),mod_at=NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND menu_id=#{menu_id}
